body: This seems like an odd restriction - "The Synopsys DWC ETHER QOS Software Driver and documentation (hereinafter "Software") is an unsupported proprietary work of Synopsys, Inc. unless otherwise expressly agreed to in writing between Synopsys and you."  Also the capitalization of "s"/"S" in the term software seems a bit muddy which adds to my confusion with this license.  Not inclined to add.

**Comment**
Not sure. Effectively a modified MIT (disclaimer) with some additional explanatory text. I would add it for differentiation from a plain MIT.

Discussed on 2025-08-14 legal team call. Based on the SPDX [license inclusion principles](https://github.com/spdx/license-list-XML/blob/main/DOCS/license-inclusion-principles.md), I'm inclined not to add this to the SPDX License List at this time.

Specifically, the license text here appears to be very specific to a single Synposys product, defining the "Software" in reference to it. It appears to state that the "Software" is a "proprietary work" of Synopsys, and references Synopsys EULAs in connection with a (partially modified) version of the MIT license text.

Given that, and looking at "Other factor" 2 in the inclusion principles, the feeling was that this license text is "specific to one . . . corporation." The references to proprietary products and Synopsys-specific EULAs doesn't fit with what we include on the license list.
